national_news.title: BRICS Leaders Adopt New Delhi Declaration Emphasizing Energy Security and Multilateral Cooperation
bullets: India hosted the two-day BRICS summit in New Delhi under the theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'.
The summit concluded with the adoption of the New Delhi Declaration, addressing geopolitical stability, West Asian crisis, and terrorism with a zero-tolerance policy.
Key outcomes include consensus on a 'BRICS Integrated Early Warning System' for infectious diseases and emphasis on diverse energy sources and market stability.

national_news.title: Defence Ministry Annual Report 2025-26 Highlights J&K Security, LAC Stability, and Domestic Defense Procurement
bullets: The Defence Ministry's annual report states that security in Jammu and Kashmir remains firmly under control with a significant decline in violence and zero stone pelting incidents.
The report noted a reduction in China's PLA deployment along the Line of Actual Control (LAC) and northern borders following diplomatic and military-level talks.
Approximately 75% of total defence procurement expenditure was directed toward domestic sources to reduce foreign import dependency and boost the local industrial base.

national_news.title: India Wins Record-Extending Eighth Women’s Asia Cup Title Defeating Sri Lanka
bullets: India defeated Sri Lanka by 72 runs in the Women’s Asia Cup 2026 final held in Dubai to secure their eighth title.
Openers Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana set up a record 129-run partnership, while bowlers Shree Charani and Deepti Sharma restricted Sri Lanka to 111 runs.
Shafali Verma was adjudged Player of the Match as India completed an unbeaten championship campaign.

national_news.title: DRI Busts Pakistan-Origin Dry Dates Import Syndicate under 'Operation Deep Manifest'
bullets: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) seized over 362 metric tonnes of Pakistan-origin dry dates in Nashik under 'Operation Deep Manifest'.
The illicit consignment was routed through Jebel Ali Port in the UAE using falsified paperwork to mask Karachi Port as the true origin.
The Government of India imposed a complete prohibition on direct or indirect imports from Pakistan effective May 2, 2025, via DGFT Notification No. 06/2025-26.

national_news.title: Defence Ministry Reports Reduction in PLA Troop Deployment Along LAC in 2025
bullets: The Ministry of Defence annual report stated that China reduced its People’s Liberation Army (PLA) force deployment along the Line of Actual Control (LAC) in 2025.
Bilateral engagement resumed through the Working Mechanism for Consultation and Coordination (WMCC) and Special Representative talks on the boundary question.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s visit to China for the SCO Summit in Tianjin in August 2025 further reinforced improving bilateral relations and border stability.

national_news.title: India Hosts BRICS Summit in Delhi; PM Modi Conducts 15 Bilateral Meetings
bullets: India hosted the BRICS Summit on September 12-13, which brought together leaders from 11 member countries, 10 partner nations, and international organizations.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi conducted 15 sit-down bilateral meetings with heads of state and government on the sidelines of the event.
Key attendees included Russian President Vladimir Putin, Chinese President Xi Jinping, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, and Abu Dhabi Crown Prince Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan.

national_news.title: NDA Governments in 21 States to Roll Out Uniform Civil Code Before 2029: HM Amit Shah
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah announced that BJP-led NDA governments across 21 states will implement the Uniform Civil Code (UCC) before 2029.
Under the new criminal justice framework of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, a system is being set up to deliver justice within three years, driving a 30% increase in conviction rates in key states.
Highlighted security achievements including the abrogation of Articles 370 and 35A, reduction of Naxalism, and the signing of over 14 peace agreements in the North-East region.

national_news.title: Hindi Diwas Celebrated; 6th All India Official Language Conference Held in Navi Mumbai
bullets: Hindi Diwas marks the adoption of Hindi in Devanagari script as India's official language by the Constituent Assembly on September 14, 1949.
The Department of Official Language, Ministry of Home Affairs, organized the 6th All India Rajbhasha Sammelan (Official Language Conference) in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra.
Union Home Minister Amit Shah presented the ‘Rajbhasha Gaurav’ and ‘Rajbhasha Kirti’ Awards for 2025-26 during the inaugural session.

national_news.title: Amit Shah Addresses 52nd Gems & Jewellery Awards, Urges Boost in Lab-Grown Diamonds
bullets: Union Home Minister Amit Shah addressed the 52nd India Gems and Jewellery Awards ceremony in Mumbai, emphasizing lab-grown diamonds as a major opportunity.
Stated that the lab-grown diamond market volume is projected to grow nearly 50 times, calling for end-to-end domestic ecosystem capabilities.
Inaugurated a manuscript exhibition titled 'Shri Ganesh Dnyanarati' at the Asiatic Society of Mumbai to promote manuscript preservation through digital technology.

national_news.title: Mizoram's 51.38-km Bairabi-Sairang Rail Line Completes One Year of Operations
bullets: The 51.38-km Bairabi-Sairang railway line in Mizoram completed one year of operation, serving over 15 lakh passengers and delivering 2,500+ freight wagons.
The rail line features 153 bridges and 45 tunnels spanning 16 km, with its tallest bridge measuring 114 metres in height.
Direct train connectivity to Delhi, Kolkata, Guwahati, and Silchar led to an 86% increase in tourism across Mizoram during its inaugural year.

national_news.title: Bairabi-Sairang Railway Project Transforms Mobility and Freight Access in Mizoram
bullets: Ministry of Railways marked one year of the Bairabi-Sairang line, inaugurated by PM Narendra Modi on September 13, 2025, extending rail connectivity near capital Aizawl.
The line incorporates 4 new stations—Hortoki, Kawnpui, Mualkhang, and Sairang—and features a 114-meter-tall bridge, 42 meters taller than the Qutub Minar.
Operationalized key long-distance services including the Sairang-Anand Vihar Rajdhani Express and Silchar passenger train, enhancing connectivity with Assam's Barak Valley.
national_news.exam_tag: UPSC / SSC CGL / Northeast Connectivity Projects

national_news.title: Rashtriya Raksha University Concludes BRICS AML/CFT Capacity Building Programme
bullets: Rashtriya Raksha University (RRU) hosted the valedictory ceremony for a five-day BRICS Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Countering the Financing of Terrorism (CFT) training programme.
The international capacity-building initiative focused on emerging risks, FATF methodologies, and strengthening cross-border financial security and compliance frameworks.
The event highlighted India’s robust AML/CFT ecosystem and high technical compliance recognized in the 2024 FATF Mutual Evaluation.

national_news.title: Prime Minister Chairs BRICS Session on Inclusive Global Governance in New Delhi
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi chaired the BRICS session on “Inclusive Global Governance and Strengthening Multilateralism” during the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi.
The Prime Minister emphasized transforming the 'pyramid of privilege' into a 'platform of partnership' to give the Global South greater representation in bodies like the UN Security Council.
Key proposals included the establishment of a Seafarers Emergency Support Network and adopting the New Delhi BRICS Leaders' Declaration.

national_news.title: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment Expands Welfare Measures for Senior Citizens
bullets: Over 2.88 lakh senior citizens have benefited from essential care, support services, shelter, and healthcare facilities under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
The government sanctioned 142 new Senior Citizen Homes across the country to expand institutional care infrastructure.
Around 23.93 lakh free assistive living devices (wheelchairs, hearing aids, walking sticks) were distributed across 228 camps for eligible BPL beneficiaries.

national_news.title: India Poutlines Key BRICS Initiatives at 18th Summit
bullets: India's BRICS Sherpa Sudhakar Dalela briefed media on key initiatives proposed during the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi.
Proposals included the BRICS Troika mechanism to ensure continuity between outgoing, current, and incoming chairs.
India pushed for a roadmap for reforming global governance structures and assistance measures for stranded seafarers and the Global South.

national_news.title: BRICS Summit 2026 Features Dravidian Architecture at Bharat Mandapam
bullets: The 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi showcased South India's architectural heritage with a grand corridor replicating the Rameswaram temple at Bharat Mandapam.
The corridor design was inspired by Tamil Nadu’s Ramanathaswamy Temple, a prominent site in the Char Dham pilgrimage circuit built in the Dravidian style.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi utilized this architectural display to showcase India's regional heritage to leaders from all eleven BRICS member nations.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Signs MoU with AIM Global Foundation to Develop Food Processing Park
bullets: The Bihar Industries Department signed an MoU with the AIM Global Foundation on the sidelines of AIM Congress 2026 in Dubai.
The partnership aims to develop an integrated agri-food and food processing cluster in Bihar to attract investments from the UAE and Gulf region.
The initiative will strengthen supply chains between farmers and industries ahead of the Rising Bihar 2026 event.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Forms 4-Member Panel to Review Assistant Professor Recruitment
bullets: Bihar Governor-cum-Chancellor constituted a four-member committee on September 12, 2026, to review and reform the assistant professor recruitment system in state universities.
The committee includes retired IAS officers Amarjeet Sinha and Sanjay Kumar, physicist Prof. H.C. Verma, and educationist Dr. P.K. Roy, and is mandated to submit its report within 90 days.
The panel was formed following a 21-day protest by the All PhD Holders and Research Association demanding transparent recruitment rules on the lines of UGC NET.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Becomes First State to Launch Dedicated Investment Policy for Sugar Industry
bullets: Bihar launched the 'Bihar Sugarcane Industry Investment Promotion Policy-2026', offering a direct grant of Rs 14 crore per year for five consecutive years (total Rs 70 crore) for new sugar mills with a minimum crushing capacity of 3,500 tonnes per day.
The policy provides up to 40 acres of land on lease at a token payment of Re 1, alongside full reimbursement of registration fees and stamp duty on land purchases.
The state government targets establishing 25 new sugar mills and restarting 9 closed mills within the next five years.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Focuses on Cultural Traditions and Educational Infrastructure Growth
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary participated in Shri Ganesh Utsav Puja organized by the Maharashtra Mandal in Patna.
An orientation program for 2,451 newly appointed assistant professors was inaugurated to strengthen the state's educational landscape.
The state government has initiated significant academic expansion, including opening 211 degree colleges in a single day.

bihar_news.title: Indian Civic Bodies Projected to Raise ₹10,000 Crore via Green Municipal Bonds
bullets: Domestic rating agency Icra projects civic bodies to raise ₹10,000 crore through green municipal bonds over the next 30 months (FY2027-FY2030).
Total urban infrastructure investments are pegged at over ₹56 lakh crore during FY27-30, with up to ₹3 lakh crore expected from commercial debt financing.
Qualifying sectors for green municipal bonds include water supply, sewerage, solid waste management, renewable energy, and climate-resilient infrastructure.

bihar_news.title: Ministry of Power Approves Power Export Up to 654 MW to Nepal
bullets: The Ministry of Power approved the export of up to 654 MW of electricity to Nepal from September 13 to December 31, 2026.
Power is permitted for 18 hours daily (00:00 to 18:00 hours) via Muzaffarpur-Dhalkebar and Tanakpur-Mahendranagar transmission lines.
The emergency measure aims to assist Nepal following severe damage to its domestic hydropower infrastructure caused by devastating flash floods.

bihar_news.title: Floods Impact 4.9 Million People Across 15 Districts in Bihar
bullets: Over 4.9 million people across 15 districts in Bihar were affected by severe floods due to incessant rains and swollen rivers flowing above danger marks.
The affected districts include Patna, Bhojpur, Saran, Vaishali, Bhagalpur, Begusarai, Buxar, Samastipur, Munger, Katihar, and others.
State administration deployed 27 SDRF and 10 NDRF teams alongside running 1,260 community kitchens and relief camps for affected populations.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Chief Minister Urges Assistant Professors to Ensure 75% Student Attendance
bullets: Bihar Deputy CM Samrat Choudhary addressed newly appointed assistant professors, urging them to ensure at least 75% student attendance in degree colleges.
The state government recently established 211 new degree colleges and appointed 2,451 assistant professors to expand higher education infrastructure, particularly in rural areas.
Highlighted that Bihar spends over 21% of its total state budget on the education sector, spanning primary, secondary, and higher education.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Send 100 Professors to Oxford and Global Institutions for Training
bullets: Bihar government announced a plan to select 100 college professors and send them for 1-month training programs at Oxford and other reputed global universities.
The initiative aims to expose state educators to international teaching standards and facilitate experience-sharing with global academic experts.
The initiative was unveiled during the orientation program for 2,451 assistant professors recruited across 211 newly created degree colleges in the state.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Launches Key Initiatives in Higher Education and Model Schools
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister inaugurated an orientation programme for 2,451 newly appointed assistant professors across 211 newly created degree colleges, making Bihar the first state to launch 211 degree colleges in a single day.
The state announced the development of 700 Saraswati Vidya Niketan model schools to provide quality education along with NEET/JEE coaching, live classes, and 24x7 online tutoring.
An initiative was announced to send 100 selected professors for training to top global institutions including Oxford University, backed by an allocation of 21% of the state budget to education.
